summary: Deterministic Networking (DetNet) promises specific guarantees, such as very low loss and bounded latency and jitter, so it needs security beyond usual best practice. This informational document covers threats and attacks, how they relate to use cases and service properties, and component-level protections such as ingress filtering and detecting packets that arrive at the wrong time. It also covers the IP and MPLS data planes.

eli5.summary: A network that promises packets always arrive on time needs extra guards, since a bully who delays a few could ruin everything. This document lists the dangers and how to guard against them.
